projectDescription: Extend the existing Beans & Brews Next.js storefront with a secure administration experience for catalog, inventory, promotions, orders, customers, support, media, content, and business reporting.

services.name: Storefront and Admin Web UI
features: Preserve the existing Beans & Brews storefront. In the navbar, hide sign-in/sign-up actions for authenticated customers and show a profile button; retain a separate admin sign-in experience with securely protected admin routes.
Provide a responsive admin dashboard with KPI cards, charts, and tables for sales, orders, inventory, and customer activity.
Support product CRUD with categories, multiple product images, BDT pricing, offers, and inventory management.
Support order management, invoice viewing or generation, user management, support workflows, promotional banners and posters, featured posts, and blog management.
Provide a fully editable customer profile, customer order history with statuses and details, and saved/favorite products.

Update checkout to collect a phone number and offer Steadfast delivery with manual fulfillment. Offer cash on delivery, bKash, and Nagad as payment choices; payments are recorded for manual verification with no payment-provider APIs.
After successful checkout, show a confirmation toast and redirect the customer to the orders page to view order status. Apply the agreed flat delivery fee.
Use Vercel Blob for uploaded product images and promotional media; use environment variables and deployment configuration for secrets, never hardcode credentials.

services.name: Next.js Application Backend
services.framework: Next.js 16 App Router route handlers and server actions
features: Implement server-side catalog, category, offer, inventory, order, invoice, customer-profile, favorite-product, support, banner/poster upload, featured-post, blog, and dashboard reporting operations.
Enforce authorization on every admin operation using Better Auth sessions and admin role checks; do not rely on client-side route hiding as the security boundary.
Use the existing Drizzle/PostgreSQL schema for authentication and extend the database schema with the commerce and content entities required by the approved scope.
Use Vercel Blob for image and poster uploads, and configure its token through environment variables.
Bootstrap the initial admin using environment variables, with no hardcoded password or committed credentials; document safe one-time setup and rotation.
Support editable customer profiles, saved/favorite products, and customer order history with statuses and details.

Collect and persist customer phone numbers at checkout. Record Steadfast as a shipping choice for manual fulfillment, and COD, bKash, or Nagad as payment methods for manual verification only; do not integrate payment-provider APIs.

Keep order totals and the flat delivery fee authoritative on the server, validate inventory and order state transitions, and return a successful-checkout result for the customer confirmation toast and orders-page redirect.
Add input validation, safe error handling, audit-worthy administrative changes, and appropriate pagination/filtering for management tables.

questions.question: What should the storefront and admin frontend include?
questions.recommendedChoice: Keep the storefront and add a responsive, protected admin dashboard for catalog, inventory, orders, users, support, media, content, and KPIs; add customer profiles, favorites, order history, and manual checkout choices.
questions.answer: Keep the existing Beans & Brews storefront. In the navbar, hide login/signup actions when signed in and show a profile button. Add a fully editable customer profile, order history with statuses/details, and saved/favorite products. Update checkout to collect a phone number, offer Steadfast with manual fulfillment, and offer COD, bKash, or Nagad recorded for manual payment verification only (no provider APIs). After successful checkout show a toast and redirect to the orders page. Apply the agreed flat delivery fee. Add a separate admin sign-in and protected admin experience with KPI cards, charts, tables; product/category CRUD, multiple images, BDT pricing, offers and inventory; order management and invoices; user management and support; banner/poster uploads, featured posts and blogs. Use responsive layouts and preserve existing application patterns.
questions.rationale: The user provided and approved the admin-dashboard scope and subsequently added customer account, order-history, favorites, checkout, manual shipping, and manual payment requirements. The user chose a flat delivery fee, manual payment verification, and manual Steadfast fulfillment.

questions.answer: Provide server-side operations for product/category/offer CRUD, inventory, orders and invoices, editable customer profiles, favorites, customer order history, user and support management, promotional media uploads, featured posts, blogs, and dashboard reporting. Enforce Better Auth admin-role authorization server-side. Extend the existing Drizzle/PostgreSQL auth schema for application data. Store uploads in Vercel Blob.
